title: UI风格#193 - Botanical Scientific (植物科学)
description: 创建第193种UI风格：植物科学风格 - 植物学插图+科学图表、精密与自然。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGK.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Scientific style When color palette Then features botanical green, aged paper, ink black
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#2D5A27 (植物绿), #F5E6C8 (旧纸), #1A1A1A (墨黑), #8B9A6B (橄榄), #4A5D23 (深绿)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Scientific style When typography Then uses scientific: EB Garamond, Libre Baskerville
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：EB Garamond (植物学), Libre Baskerville (经典), Source Serif (替代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Scientific style When layout Then botanical illustration layout, specimen plates, crosshatching
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：植物学插图布局、标本板、交叉阴影

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Scientific style When UI elements Then ink illustration, specimen labels, measurement marks
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：墨水插图、标本标签、测量标记

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Scientific UI When functional Then includes specimen chat, botanist agents, flora stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：标本聊天、植物学家代理、植物群统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Scientific UI When copy Then uses botanical: 'Specimen', 'Flora', 'Cultivar', 'Genus'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'SPECIMEN. FLORA. GENUS.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'CATALOG'、'DEPLOY'→'CULTIVATE'
